comment: The development builds' ids, let in by debug builds and by builds with the dev-extension feature, never by a release. The Chromium origin is pinned by a developer's own key, kept out of every repository: without the public key nobody else can build an extension with this id. The Firefox id is ours only once our AMO submission has claimed it; until then anyone could get it signed there, so it stays here and goes into allowed-origins.json only after that submission.
